scripts.prepackage: node -e "const frontendDir = require('path').resolve(__dirname, '..', 'adyx-frontend'); require('child_process').execSync('npx vite build', {stdio: 'inherit', cwd: frontendDir}); require('fs').cpSync(require('path').join(frontendDir, 'dist'), 'app', {recursive: true, force: true})"
scripts.build: npm run prepackage && npm run package && npm run installer
